description: A Java class 'LogView' that extends TextView and implements LogNode, used for displaying log data received through the LogNode interface in an Android application.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting log data received via LogNode interface.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and outputs it to the LogView, also passing it to the next LogNode if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to StringBuilder if it is not null.
